say:1:1530701001:1.text: Of course I do. She's our high priestess. Everyone knows her.
say:1:1530701001:1.source_cn: 当然，加拉是雅库伯尔的大祭司，谁会不认识她？
say:1:1530701001:1.male: Of course I do. She's our high priestess. Everyone knows her.
say:1:1530701001:1.female: Of course I do. She's our high priestess. Everyone knows her.
